skills.name: brave_search
skills.description: Search the web using Brave Search API. Returns top results with titles, URLs, snippets, and optional AI-generated summaries. Requires BRAVE_API_KEY environment variable.

skills.name: check_website
skills.description: Fetch a URL and return its status code, response time, and page body content.

skills.name: count_words
skills.description: Count the number of words, characters, and sentences in a text.

skills.name: debug_council_memory
skills.description: Test council memory read/write. Writes a test insight, searches for it, and lists recent entries.

skills.name: debug_list_skills
skills.description: List all registered skills. Returns name, description, tags, and permissions for each.

skills.name: debug_memory_check
skills.description: Test private memory read/write. Saves a test entry, searches for it, and reports dimension and embedding model.

skills.name: debug_nats_ping
skills.description: Test NATS connection. Checks is_connected, publishes a broadcast test message, and reports status.

skills.name: debug_ping_agent
skills.description: Send a NATS direct message to a target agent_id asking for a ping. Waits up to 10s for reply and reports round-trip time or timeout.

skills.name: debug_redis_ping
skills.description: Test Redis connectivity. SET a test key with TTL, GET it back, DEL it, and report round-trip time.

skills.name: debug_reload_skills
skills.description: Call skill_registry.load_all() and compare before/after lists. Report new, removed, and changed skills.

skills.name: debug_show_config
skills.description: Read Settings() and return formatted agent configuration: agent_id, model, embedding, database, redis, nats, llm_base_url, timezone.

skills.name: roll_dice
skills.description: Roll one or more dice and return the results. Specify the number of dice and sides.

skills.name: web_search
skills.description: Search the web using a local SearXNG instance. Returns top results with titles, URLs, and snippets. Configure categories, engines, and max results via environment variables.
